svg.title: Boss stage: Fishing Boat Safety System
svg.desc: Capsize and distress detection for small Kerala fishing boats. A Random Forest runs on the ESP32 itself and relays the alert to shore over LoRa, so it works exactly where there is no signal. Power-ups: ESP32, C/C++, emlearn, LoRa, FastAPI, React. Quest 1 of 7: sensing rig. Animation: a fishing boat under a storm sends an alert packet to a lighthouse on shore.
